sources.note: Main website. Describes Tebra as all-in-one EHR+ platform for independent practices, 150K+ providers. Lists EHR, billing, patient experience, and marketing modules.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists certified criteria, additional software (LabSoft, Updox, DrFirst Rcopia, SmileCDR). States EHI export available in C-CDA, PDF, and native formats. Links to FHIR API docs.

Full features page. Details AI charting, e-prescriptions, labs, telehealth, intake forms, portal, billing (eligibility, claims, RPA, statements), scheduling, reminders, marketing, reputation management.
EHR-specific product page. Describes SOAP templates, AI Note Assist, SALT pull-forward, macros, integrated prescriptions/labs/imaging ordering, telehealth, intake forms.
Integrations landing page. General discussion of EHR integration concepts but does not list specific integration partners. References labs, imaging centers, referral partners.

Billing and payments page. Details insurance eligibility (2,700+ payers via X12 270/271), electronic claims, ERA/EOB auto-posting via RPA, patient payments (card-on-file, online, QR codes), automated statements, denial management.
Patient portal page. Describes patient access to medical history, medications, labs, treatment plans, secure messaging, bill viewing/payments, guest access, document sharing.
November 2021 merger announcement. Kareo + PatientPop merge to form Tebra. ~1,000 employees, 100K+ providers, 85M patients. Dan Rodrigues (Kareo founder) as CEO.
December 2025 $250M funding announcement. 140K+ providers, 125M patient records. AI Note Assist generated 500K+ notes. RCM AI for automated coding/claims. Led by Hildred with J.P. Morgan debt.

Capterra listing. 3.9/5 stars from 1,311 reviews. Users note ease of use, AI documentation, billing issues (clearinghouse rejections, desktop app requirement), data export costs. Formerly listed as Kareo.
TrustRadius pros/cons page. Referenced in search results for user feedback on charting, billing, and customer support.
HIT Consultant coverage of Kareo-PatientPop merger forming Tebra. Describes combined company creating all-in-one provider platform.
Fierce Healthcare coverage of merger. Confirms Kareo's clinical/financial software combined with PatientPop's growth technology.
Fierce Healthcare coverage of earlier $72M funding round that pushed valuation above $1B.
Software Finder listing with pricing and feature overview for Tebra EHR.
Brand story page describing the Kareo + PatientPop to Tebra transition.
Telehealth page. HIPAA/HITRUST certified video visits, up to 200 participants, virtual waiting rooms, dedicated provider URLs.
